description: This file defines the EmployeeGender class, a filter field used in reports within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with query builders to filter employees based on gender, providing methods for query modification, entity aliasing, and value normalization.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: A filter field class for employee gender, capable of modifying queries and normalizing input values.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a gender filter condition to the query builder based on the operator and value.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in query context, here 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the internal value to an array with id and label, representing gender.
